<color name=#ffffff>LIMITED EDITION
Test Collection/Newsgirl. Available only in certain regions, this remake of a classic design utilizes the best materials and contains carefully-sewn details. An extra custom-made letter opener is included.</color>

Test Collection/Species Plantarum. Available only in certain regions, this remake of a classic design utilizes the best materials carefully hand-sewn details. An extra custom-made multifunctional tool bag is included.

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/Fresh Fastener. An outfit worn by Amiya while working for a Rhodes Island restaurant. This poofy coat is cold-resistant, and has enough room to hold something penguin-sized.</color>

Test Collection Series/Seedsower. A loose yet comfortable outdoors fit. Comes with an exclusive miniature mountain-grade rucksack and an agricultural nursery kit. The designer has one small wish of her own, and hopes that we can all help to realize it.
Test Collection Series/The Law. The jailer garments Saria used when entering Mansfield State Prison, largely in line with the female jailer's standard uniform.

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/Focus. The attire Phantom wore when he left for the castle, and the costume for his maiden performance. After an age of gathering dust, it finally sees the light of day again.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/Traceless Walker. Custom-made by the Lateran Curia for certain Legati. Sankta who get custom outfits all share a common feature: there is something unusual about their halos.</color>

Test Collection Series/Snowstorm Invitation. An outfit tailor-made by Karlan Trade for their affiliated business negotiators. First impressions are of the utmost importance in trade talks. Steward knows this well, and has never failed to live up to expectations.
Test Collection Series/Summer Feast. Mizuki wears this when feasting on the beach. The material is stain-resistant and provides plenty of room for extra appendages.

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/Midnight Delivery. As part of our cooperation agreement, Rhodes Island ordered this operator uniform for Exusiai. She can be seen wearing it, from time to time, during operations in Lungmen.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/There They Be. Saga's attire when she left P'o-shan Village, with Biteys for pockets and straw sandals. What is in the scrolls cannot be removed, but after so much time spent with oneselves, what was drawn in ink is now etched in the heart.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/Bunch of Sunlight. Outfit specially designed for going out. It uses the operator's main color as basic tone and matches it with a different-colored jacket for a vivid contrast.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/After Storm. Frost inevitably gives way to a clear day. Ch'en Hui-chieh patrols the city in her first L.G.D. uniform, re-inspecting the metropolis both familiar and foreign to her.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/Phase Face. Clothes that show off both Tin Man's classical and surrealist sides. The final design was put together using Furnace illusions. A sense of strangeness blurs the line between illusion and reality.</color>
displaySkin.usage: One of Tin Man's casual outfits.

displaySkin.content: <color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/Diversity Oneness. A possibility derived from when Virtuosa connected to the Law: emotions link together the hearts of all. The performer who once plucked at their heartstrings is now no more than a voice in the chorus.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/Allmind As One. A possibility derived from when Executor connected to the Law: connected consciousnesses tend towards unity, all to achieve one goal. Exsequi. Exsequi. Exsequi.</color>
displaySkin.usage: One of Executor the Ex Foedere's casual outfits.

displaySkin.content: <color name=#ffffff>Test Birthday Collection 1101/Solo Around The World. The Ark cradling the cocoon of dreams sailed into the galaxy, dissolving into millions of threads. With love as their needle, the many hands crafted a one-of-a-kind garment for Amiya. The remaining threads, intertwined with wishes, were fashioned into a violin.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/Moonlit Voyage. Themed around the night sky, the moon, and oceanic voyages, the dream-like weave of star and sea feels like going on a fantastical journey, with drifting moon and stars as companions.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/Supernova. Clothes Wiš'adel wears when stepping into the unknown of space to corral Originium run wild. According to her, since she's here to clean up the trash, she should wear something suitable for the occasion.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/Glory of the Devout. Nun's habit that has been altered, with adjustments for the wearer's racial characteristics. Paired with accessories that reflect one's personal style.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/The Remains of Time. An outfit worn by Kal'tsit while in disguise. Countless times, in this manner, she influenced the course of Terra's civilization—ripples in the great river of time, a fleeting mark on her endless journey.</color>
<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/Unruly Humbleness. Bartender and bar-owner Lappland, with some of her colleagues in tow, happily welcomes in tonight's employer and Boss.</color>
displaySkin.usage: One of Lappland the Decadenza's casual outfits.

displaySkin.content: <color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/In A Myriad of Universes. A journey of pursuit embarked upon by Amiya. Perhaps uncontrolled Originium destroys an entire world, but across countless universes, she will ultimately find you, find hope.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/An Airy Dream. Rosmontis's lavender dream. In this dream, soft flowers bloom deep in her memories, and Rosmontis's skirt billows with the wind, leaping towards a light future with her companions.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/Quiet Move. A master move made by Zuo Le. He has played his own shadow across boards and grids. Over time, he learned that while the patterns are many, the wisdom behind them is one.</color>
displaySkin.usage: One of Zuo Le's casual outfits.

displaySkin.content: <color name=#ffffff>Test Collection Series/Yet Another Autumn. The autumn sun shines gently, its light falling with the ginkgo leaves onto her white dress. Charlotte looks up from under her wide-brimmed hat, feeling the wind's whisper with her fingers.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>A uniform from Victoria's Wessex Middle School, adapted by traditional Victorian designers. Centuries of rich heritage combines with excellent craftsmanship to make a light and comfortable outfit.</color>
EPOQUE New Arrivals/Unknown Journey. Trendy, made for the spring season, well-fitting and comfortable, comes with a choice of accessories that can be mixed and matched to suit your style.

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE First Edition/Combat Medic. Based upon a special-issue Ádakrys battlesuit, it has blades attached in the right parts to give off an extremely aggressive look. Gavial describes it as her ideal 'battlefield trappings.'</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE New Arrivals/Serenity. Casual clothing centered around black and purple as main colors to exude a bit of elegance while still maintaining a calm feel. A favorite among women in the workplace, this outfit was Ptilopsis's first choice when going out.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Invisible Dirge. Taking the model's peculiar traits in consideration, this outfit was completed without being tailored. Combines comfort, fashion, and a proper fit while also protecting the operator's vitals.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Light and Shadow. A trendy, vintage Victorian appeal, modified to Nightmare's specifications. Some decorative elements will change when Nightmare's personality shifts.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Spellbreaker. A Laterano dress with corresponding weapons. Generally, only Sankta who have presided over the ceremonies are allowed to wear it, and Mostima seems to have quietly snuck out with this outfit.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Starseeker. One of the intricate outfits worn by Astesia only in the grandest occasions of Columbia's social life. Merely donning this outfit is a statement of its own.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE New Series/Miraculous Moment. Casual clothes that capture the region's impressions while taking the customer's preferences in consideration. After a deep dive into the customer's life, the designer collaborated with the customer to add a variety of supporting accessories.</color>
EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Fugue. Ordinary Sarkaz mercenary wear. Easy to mend, protective, and carries even more explosives after simple modification.
<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Willpower. Classic Siracusan womenswear. By request of Texas, all parts once white have been dyed completely black.</color>
EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Lieutenant. Clothing modified from Bolívarian military uniform, with some accessories coming from Dobermann's own collection.
EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Infiltrator. This clothing is styled exactly as Ethan used to wear, but closer-fitting, cozier, making him somewhat unwilling to change out of it.

EPOQUE New Arrivals/Eggcellent Craftsman. Greyy made an exquisite eight-tone musical egg as a present for his close friends, and in exchange, they custom-ordered him this outfit brimming with holiday atmosphere.
EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Weißer Sand. Home leisure style, a present from Carnelian to Beeswax. She believed this one would fit her most, and knew Beeswax would like it.

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Londinium Style Miko. Home leisure style, standard apparel for Victorian housekeeping staff. The pattern on the skirt hem was embroidered in improvisation by Tsukinogi, who seems to have misunderstood this clothing's use case.</color>

EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Leisurely Afternoon. Home leisure style, relaxed and pleasing to the eye, graceful and cozy. Comes with a pair of adorable fitted slippers, for an afternoon completely free of cares wherever you are.
EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Wake Up From a Nap. Home leisure style, selected for Podenco by Lena. Similar colors to Podenco's original clothing, but with a complete change of style.

EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Bard's Holiday. Trendy autumn attire, loose and breathable. Incorporates a unique multi-layer pocket design, convenient for holding all sorts of lightweight souvenirs during a serendipitous sojourn.

EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Glory Purple. Zofia's attire when she participated in the Kazimierz Major awards ceremony. The right choice of attire made her the center of attention during the ceremony.
<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Light Gold Celebration. Generalissimo Myrtle's attire during her triumphant return. Stand at attention–– and salute!</color>
EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Heritage. Traditional Minoan ritual attire, coordinated with modern themes, is once again in vogue among Minoans.

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Masterpiece. The outfit worn by Natalya Andreyevna Rostova, student council president of Chernobog #4 Secondary School, during her commencement speech.</color>
EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Silent Arrow. An Iberian classic, enhanced with the customer's own artistic touches. Andreana particularly appreciates this outfit's moisture resistance.

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Gift of Wild. The choice of the Columbian pioneer, with a core emphasis on strong and durable design. The added details give this outfit that extra personal touch.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Series New Release/Appreciate Fragrance. Finely-crafted Victorian dress, handmade from the finest materials. An elegant and dignified outfit bound to garner attention anywhere.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Series New Release/Plant Crude Drug. Practical outfit worn by Mulberry for both relief and horticultural work, with enough pockets for all her tools. Green trimmings adorn the simple fabric, representing verdant life.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Alighting. Magnum opus of a Yumen craftsman, given to a traveler heading on a long journey. In the hope that men and might need no longer be a burden, that he can wander for myriad li with ease.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Heavenly Mirage. Recreation of a Lungmen VIP's childhood fantasy. She enters the Xians' abode, dressed in celestial garb, skirts dark as kohl, jade pure as ice, face austere, serene. Transcendent.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/The Land With Me. Handmade by a Lungmen craftsman, inspired by Yanese landscape paintings. Thanks to weaving and dyeing techniques rarely seen in the modern age, mounts and seas emerge from the nichang's fabric, blurring fantasy and reality.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Saturated Within Rain. Handmade by a Lungmen craftsman, matching a scene of beauty and wonder recorded in an ancient tome. Remember to bring a paper umbrella, for within, the drops of ink now fall as gentle rains.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>0011 New Arrivals/Yearly Present. Purestream dons new clothes and brings a gift for her visit, the trendy multi-layered style unable to hide the bright colors of Yan—the hem's red lining and the pendants on her staff and her waist come together in harmonious ingenuity.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>0011 New Arrivals/Spring Feast. Outfit Shu wore during a feast held by her family. A beauteous purple robe across her shoulders, a silken skirt along her legs. Here, a goddess lies, quietly watching the turning of the seasons.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>0011 New Arrivals/Youthful Journey. Outfit Zuo Le wore when using the Tianshi Bureaus' training grounds. Integrated with elements of the Tianshi gown, enabling mobility while highlighting his youthful spirit.</color>
displaySkin.usage: One of Zuo Le's casual outfits.

displaySkin.content: <color name=#ffffff>0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/A Gallant Dream. Bestial pattern on robe of white, silver plate on black of gown, adorned with jade, an ensemble unfettered. The gongs of the border's night watch ring out, while Ling seeks the great Dao in woven dream.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Hazy Jade. The painter of a thousand forms, wrapped in jade silk. The soul who sculpts ink into shape, entwined in kohl silk. The gauze stretches out before her, serving as her infinite canvas.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>0011 New Arrivals/Clear Morning View. Clothes Yu wears when getting ingredients for the reunion dinner. The gold-embroidered top under his cyan jacket billows in the wind. Amidst verdant green, the young man begins his return to his dream of a family gathering.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>0011 New Arrivals/By the Lamplight. Clothes Surfer wore while sightseeing during the lantern display. A dignified, elegant jacket is draped over an avant-garde red silk top, just like the wearer's cautious exterior hides a daring heart.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>0011 New Arrivals/An Opera of Flowers. Costume Philae wore while taking part in a traditional Yanese opera. A pale pink robe boasts sleeves of pure white, drawing in even graceful butterflies, who flutter about and rest by her side.</color>
<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Series New Release/Cultivate Vegetation. Rugged traditional Sargon outfit, suitable for long journeys. The new collar details give the wearer a closer fit.</color>
<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Disguise. Home leisure style, snug and cozy material. Dark purple and tangerine yellow collide for a full-on sense of vogue.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Book Reader. Traditional Victorian textiles and tailoring, every cut made by the hands of craftsmen, its custom-made monochrome cloth premium without being conspicuous.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Temperament. Adroit tailoring and a rich modern sense for color, contrasted with accessories detailed with classical appeal. Spectacles are custom-made as a gift by the brand, for the client.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Justice Maker. Attire of Wild Mane during repairs of 'Justice Knight.' Cozy and breathable, while wear and stain resistant. Detailing and accessories in contrasting colors coordinated to embody that sense of planning.</color>
displaySkin.usage: One of Wild Mane's casual outfits.

displaySkin.content: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Dream In A Moment. Two sets of clothing held in Passenger's memories and casually put to paper, then realized as outfits by a snooping Operator.
displaySkin.usage: One of Elliot and Passenger's casual outfits.

displaySkin.content: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Relight. One of the many suits of armor worn by Nearl in her debut competition season, this one a modification of a campaign knight suit.
displaySkin.usage: One of Nearl the Radiant Knight's casual outfits.

displaySkin.content: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Become Anew. Rosmontis's attire while still a test subject, adorned only by detectors and inhibitors.
displaySkin.usage: One of Rosmontis's past lab outfits.

displaySkin.content: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Wildness Behind. The clothes Honeyberry envisioned during her studies as she described her own prospects to her sickly mother, their intricacies drawn from her mother's wardrobe.

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Melodiosa. Sora's outfit in her time studying and performing at Siracusa's Teatro di Milano. Siracusan musical productions have a unique cultural flair, which in turn calls for accessorizing to match.</color>

EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Distant Home's Guide. The plainclothes Quercus once wore on an infiltration mission. Principally serving to conceal her identity, so as to better facilitate combat in city environs.

EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Ingenious Servant. A bespoke outfit ordered at the Savile Boutique Tailors by Kjera, the finished product of bewildering quality thanks to the fantastic minds of the designers, plus Kjera's own clever touch.

displaySkin.skinName: A Drip of Orea and Potamous
displaySkin.content: <color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/A Drip of Orea and Potamous. Designed for the climate of Minos, slim-fitting and easy to move in. The fabric is durable, waterproof, and resistant to the occasional spilled wine. Can be customized with extras to the customer's needs.</color>
EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Under A Veil. Manticore once wore it on a mission in Sargon, and was bothered by the clanging of the gold accessories as she moved.
<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Paper Wing. White jacket on mint-green T-shirt, refreshingly cool for the summer.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Yukibare. Suzuran's outfit on a winter morning trip to the shrine. The loose-fitting sleeves protect against the wind and snow, while the pleated front adds an exotic touch.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Tsukiyoi. Custom-made for Mint, integrating Victorian style into traditional Higashinese garb. Comfy yet unique, it is one of Mint's favorites on festive occasions.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Betsushi. Traditional Higashinese outfit made from the highest-quality fabric, colorful yet minimalistic. Comfortable and warm, an ideal choice for outdoor trips in autumn.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Fantastic Crafts. Astesia and her sister wore this for a machine design competition. Lightweight, durable, and easy to clean, a stylish outfit for a hard-worker.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/To Effloresce Whitely. A gown for Victorian nobles woven with fine muslin, fragrant and supple flowers gracing the pure white skirt. A quiet elegance, delicate and sublime.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/A Thousand Correspondences. A custom outfit made of fine and lightweight material, tailored based on Heidi's descriptions of her childhood summers. Though it feels different from how she remembers.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Invitation. A set of formalwear Harmonie wears while enjoying the afternoon in her study. The smart tailoring makes her skirt move in a beautiful curve, and the fabrics are specially chosen to hide any stray fur stuck on her clothes.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Her Aspiration. The clothes Astgenne wore in her rented home. A lab coat thrown over an elegant and close fit, for she must always be ready for a whimsical stroke of inspiration for her experiments.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sunny Day. Cardigan's outfit when she had just arrived at a city in southern Leithanien. Skillfully tailored to fit a young girl's stature. Light, airy, and blooming with vitality.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/The Other Side of Siracusa. Does he not occasionally wear a plain jacket and hoodie instead of a tailored suit, and sit-down at a not-quite traditional Siracusan restaurant?</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Gwiazdcytrony. Meteor's winter clothes from back in Kazimierz. Balancing lightness and warmth, they also allow one to easily hide in dense forests. A reproduction.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/W Dali. Młynar's attire as a knight-errant, wandering Kazimierz's plains and endless forests, the words engraved on the hilt of his sword not yet covered by useless trinkets.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Royal Guardswoman. Bagpipe's uniform as a new cadet at the military academy, doubling as formal wear. Training in formal wear was yet another duty of a royal guardsman cadet.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Noon Twilight. Absinthe's former school uniform. In Ursus, students wear their uniforms while exercising, resembling a field of neatly spaced seedlings behind a plow.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Lances of Kaliskas. Ashlock's formalwear, worn when her family banished her. Traditional dress worthy of a Kazimierz knight, not entirely inappropriate on her.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Amidst the Pieces. Puzzle knows that he should tailor his attire to his target—one of the most efficient ways to win trust and exchange intel. When alone, however, he barely spares a thought to his appearance.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Nighttime Café. Always meticulous, Ansel likes to be properly dressed at the café as well. He steadfastly refuses to sell coffee at night, however.</color>
<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Curator. Scholar's garb straight from a fairy tale. Stuff your magic, knowledge, and curiosity in the pockets, and take notes with Reed.</color>
displaySkin.usage: One of Reed the Flame Shadow's casual outfits.

displaySkin.content: <color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Private Study. Mint's formalwear at the Victorian Institution for Higher Studies, the green waistband showing off her lines and individuality.</color>
<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Major Field. Practical yet dignified, it protects from the elements on field surveys, but can also be worn under a jacket for conferences.</color>

<color name=#000000>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Courtesy. Lungmen's latest trend, seamlessly blending ancient and modern Yanese charm. To Qiubai, the art of tea and the sword are the same in that both require full attention and to know when to stop.</color>

<color name=#000000>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Leisure. The season's latest leisurewear in Columbia. Detachable straps and pouches let Corroserum show off the many delights of his spring travels.</color>

<color name=#000000>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/New Business. Cement's survey consultant outfit. Snug and durable, the contrast of the hoodie and jacket brings out her vitality. She also gets herself a pair of goggles to match with them.</color>

<color name=#000000>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Season of Travel. Pinecone's outfit while visiting family in Columbia. The jacket's jade trim outlines the simple dress with a vibrant aura. An unintentional pairing, yet perfect for spring.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Habitat. Silence's dress for public events. She's been busy of late, and drifts to sleep in front of the camera. Luckily, she has Ifrit's handmade alarm clock to help her stay awake.</color>
displaySkin.usage: One of Silence the Paradigmatic's casual outfits.

displaySkin.content: <color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/I Am the Tides. An outfit Gladiia often wears. With the tides, she comes and goes freely between land and sea. The hunter is at ease, for the hunter is the tide.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Scribing. The dust settles, the noise stops, and Nuova Volsinii finally quiets down. Here, the judge sheds her robes of the law, and with pen in hand, she writes of the turmoil that once rocked Siracusa.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Cardwinner. Tequila's formal stage outfit. Qualified hosts heat up the audience; excellent hosts strive to eliminate any errant possibility.</color>

<color name=#000000>Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Never-melting Ice. One of SilverAsh's suits, tailored for important events. The weight of the name of Silverash clan can tear rifts across Terra. Even majestic glaciers and roiling clouds make way for him.</color>

<color name=#000000>Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Rhythmic Blocks. Swire's chic and breezy concert outfit, showcasing all her vivacity and cuteness. She leads the choreography, gladly accepting the applauses and affection from her stans.</color>

displaySkin.content: <color name=#ffffff>Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Melodic Flutter. Clothes Ines wore when posing for a music-themed portrait. <color name=#fffff>Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Empty Crown. Outfit Stainless tailored for himself. With unique armor designs and bold weapon modifications, he has successfully recreated the image of a heroic knight in his heart.</color>

<color name=#fffff>Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Golden Reverie. Dress carefully picked by Muelsyse. The top is bright and brazen, like the early dawnlight, and the skirt is soft and sable, like the moons playing across a still lake—a perfect union of luxury and solemnity.</color>

<color name=#fffff>Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Radiant Serenity. Clothes Logos wore as a guest at the Liches' spire. Golden moons and stars adorn a base of blue-gray fabric, graceful yet profound.</color>

<color name=#fffff>Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Ethereal Harmony. Stage clothing picked by conductor Mostima herself. A mysterious blue serves as the main hue, a blue of grace and beauty, a fitting accompaniment to the stage she built.</color>

<color name=#fffff>Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Prelude to Transcendence. Clothes Surtr wore to the theater. The fiery train symbolizing the flame of her soul, the gold-trimmed white performing the song of her mind.</color>

<color name=#fffff>Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Blooming Reverie. Satin dress Nymph chose for herself. The fluttering hem complements her flower-shaped updo, turning her into an elegant fairy dancing in the garden, lively and graceful.</color>

<color name=#fffff>Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Unstained, Unshaken. Outlined in sharp lines and painted in cold tones, revealing the wearer's pioneering, problem-smashing fearlessness in full color.</color>

<color name=#fffff>Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Requiem Vesperis. Robes for Vespers specially made for Lemuen. May her pure light be as the twilight stars, granting all a blessing of peace amidst the interplay of light and shadow.</color>

<color name=#fffff>Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/As Clear As Crystal. Necrass's dress for the musical. The inner lining bedecked with stars is the abyss of the past, the radiant outer surface the resolute present. Through crystal and steel, her will carries on.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>The Legend of Luo Xiaohei Collaborative Series/Before Singing. Glossy texturing and a bright palette make for materials that shout energy, while contour-hugging innerwear pairs with a loose-fit jacket to provide both comfort and chic.</color>

<color name=#ffffff>Monster Hunter Collaborative Series/Fly Into the Street. The Felynes are amped with excitement for getting some Terra-style fresh fits on, and spray paint-filled cans especially pique their curiosity. Noir Corne senses something big and bad's about to go down.</color>

displaySkin.usage: One of Executor the Ex Foedere's casual outfits.

displaySkin.content: <color name=#ffffff>Brand Collaborative Series/Wanderer in the Rain. Raindrops slide down his clear umbrella to his feet, and the night wind lifts the hem of his white coat. Though the path ahead remains unclear, he knows where to go.</color>
